description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of training steps for several model types and sizes, using a dataset of 20 million data points. The x-axis is labeled “Step” and has a linear scale ranging from 0k to 440k, with tick labels at 0k, 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 420k, and 440k. The y-axis is labeled “Train Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.85, with tick labels at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8. There are six lines shown: a blue solid line representing ChemBERT Small 20M, which begins at approximately 0.82 at 0k and decreases to approximately 0.15 at 440k; a green dashed line representing ChemBERT Medium 20M, which begins at approximately 0.82 at 0k and decreases to approximately 0.13 at 440k; a purple dashed line representing ChemLaMA Small 20M, which begins at approximately 0.82 at 0k and decreases to approximately 0.14 at 440k; a red solid line representing ChemLaMA Medium 20M, which begins at approximately 0.82 at 0k and decreases to approximately 0.12 at 440k; a brown solid line representing BART Small 20M, which begins at approximately 0.82 at 0k and decreases to approximately 0.14 at 440k; and an orange solid line representing RoBERTa Small 20M, which begins at approximately 0.82 at 0k and decreases to approximately 0.13 at 440k.
